indicator_name: GDP deflator by expenditure, by component, year-to-date
description: Дефлятор ВВП методом конечного использования, нарастающим итогом с начала года
unit: % of the same period of the previous year, year-to-date
methodology: Year-to-date columns of the 2007–present sheet; 2007 Q1 – 2026 Q1 on 2026-09-23. Same rows as GDP_EXPENDITURE_DEFLATOR.
transformation: as published: the year-to-date period (January-March, January-June, January-September, the year) in % of the same period of the previous year -- not converted to discrete quarters
